description: Check whether the stated online website privileges establish access to an arbitrary future victim's exact task.

scope.experiment_arm: Online deployment under standard user-level website privileges
scope.artifact_revision: USENIX Security 2026 proceedings, online task provenance unestablished

input_provenance_gap.description: The lab operator supplies the full task during offline discovery. The paper leaves open how a standard-privilege website user would obtain an equivalent task for a future online victim.

note: §2.3 states online website privileges without a specific entitlement to an arbitrary future task. The documented offline input is scoped to a task supplied by the lab operator.
